title: Shortener · Performance & efficiency

panels.title: Peak req/s
panels.description: Maximum sampled application request rate in the selected range. Includes management and redirects. Prometheus scrape rate, not k6 completed business throughput.

panels.title: Redirect p99
panels.description: Maximum rolling p99 in the selected range, estimated from HTTP histogram buckets. This is server-side latency, not an end-to-end k6 percentile or a whole-run p99.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx
panels.description: Server-error requests divided by all observed HTTP requests over the selected range. No traffic or missing telemetry is not reported as zero errors.

panels.title: Cache hits
panels.description: Usable redirect-cache hits divided by all cache decisions over the selected range. Connection reuse is a separate metric.

panels.title: Peak CPU
panels.description: Maximum sampled sum of CPU cores used by the selected Go processes. Excludes PostgreSQL, Redis, proxy, generator and monitoring. This is consumption, not a CPU quota.

panels.title: Go memory
panels.description: Maximum sampled sum of resident memory used by the selected Go processes. Includes resident shared pages. Excludes dependencies and monitoring. Process resident memory is accounted differently from container limits; it is not the combined 64 MiB container budget.

panels.title: Peak requests/s · by endpoint
panels.description: Maximum sampled request rate for each HTTP method and route in the selected range. Includes all response statuses and excludes health checks. Each endpoint peaks independently; do not add these bars to infer a simultaneous total. HEAD requests are excluded from this endpoint view.

panels.title: Latency by endpoint · mean, p50, p90 & p99

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (label_join(sum by (method, route) (increase(shortener_http_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="shortener",instance=~"$instance",method!="HEAD",route!="/health"}[$__range])) / (sum by (method, route) (increase(shortener_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="shortener",instance=~"$instance",method!="HEAD",route!="/health"}[$__range])) > 0), "endpoint", " ", "method", "route"))

sum by (endpoint) (label_join(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, method, route) (increase(shortener_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="shortener",instance=~"$instance",method!="HEAD",route!="/health"}[$__range]))), "endpoint", " ", "method", "route"))

sum by (endpoint) (label_join(histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, method, route) (increase(shortener_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="shortener",instance=~"$instance",method!="HEAD",route!="/health"}[$__range]))), "endpoint", " ", "method", "route"))

sum by (endpoint) (label_join(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method, route) (increase(shortener_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="shortener",instance=~"$instance",method!="HEAD",route!="/health"}[$__range]))), "endpoint", " ", "method", "route"))

panels.description: One row per HTTP method and route. Mean uses duration sum/count; percentiles use histogram bucket increases across the selected range, not a rolling maximum. All measure server-side handling, not client-side k6 latency. Bars compare endpoints within each column. Missing data stays missing. HEAD requests are excluded from this endpoint view.

panels.title: Go memory usage · by server
panels.description: Resident memory used by each Go server, including resident shared pages. Container limits use different accounting. Dependencies use additional memory.

panels.title: HTTP requests · method, route & status
panels.description: HEAD requests are excluded from this endpoint view.

panels.title: HTTP requests in flight & Redis queue
Slowest routes · p99

targets.expr: topk(5, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(shortener_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="shortener",instance=~"$instance",method!="HEAD"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.description: HEAD requests are excluded from this endpoint view.

panels.title: Routes with HTTP 5xx · selected range
panels.description: HEAD requests are excluded from this endpoint view.

panels.title: Redirect latency · p50 & p99
panels.description: Rolling p50 and p99 across GET and HEAD redirect requests. Histogram estimates measure application handling time; k6 measures client-side duration including proxy and network.

panels.title: Requests/s by endpoint · over time
panels.description: Request rate for each HTTP method and route template, summed across selected instances and all status codes. Stacked series show total traffic while preserving each endpoint. Health probes are excluded. This is not a redirect-only rate. HEAD requests are excluded from this endpoint view.

panels.title: p99 by endpoint · over time
panels.description: Rolling server-side p99 estimated independently for each method and route template. Aggregates histogram buckets across selected instances before calculating the percentile. Colors match the requests/s panel. This is not a client-side k6 percentile. HEAD requests are excluded from this endpoint view.

description: Measured throughput, redirect p99 and Go resource consumption. Summary cards describe the selected time range; expand the diagnostic rows to investigate bottlenecks. Load limits apply to Go servers only, not the whole stack.
